title: Maria's Birthday Party
text:
Maria has a birthday party on Saturday. She wants to invite her friends. She writes invitations on blue paper. The party starts at four o'clock at her house.

Tom gets an invitation from Maria. He is happy. He says yes and he brings a red gift. Maria says thank you and smiles.

questions.text: What color is the gift that Tom brings?
How does Maria feel when Tom says yes?

options: She wants to go to school.
She wants her friends to come to the party.
She wants to buy a gift.

vocabulary.definition: cards or messages that ask people to come to an event
an event where people meet to eat, talk and have fun
something that you give to another person
moves the mouth up to show that you are happy

paragraph_translations: María tiene una fiesta de cumpleaños el sábado. Ella quiere invitar a sus amigos. Escribe invitaciones en papel azul. La fiesta empieza a las cuatro en su casa.
Tom recibe una invitación de María. Él está contento. Dice que sí y trae un regalo rojo. María dice gracias y sonríe.
